title: SMS API: a token bucket that keeps punishing clients after they back off
name: SMS send rate limiter

questions.prompt: Several trial customers whose integrations retry on every 429 say they get locked out of POST /v1/messages for a long time, even after they slow down to one message a second. The Retry-After header they get keeps going up the more they retry. One customer also says a short OTP was refused right after a long marketing message got a 429. Fix tokenBucket.ts so the tests pass.
